# TeleVault

> TeleVault is an open-source, multi-tenant web application and MTProto downloader enabling direct browser streaming, on-the-fly streaming ZIP packaging, and batch media downloads from Telegram channels, groups, and direct chats without storing files on intermediate server disks.

## Core Capabilities
- **Direct Browser Streaming**: Stream Telegram video, audio, and documents (up to 4GB Telegram Premium limit) directly into browser memory/disk via HTTP chunked transfer and range requests.
- **Zero Server Storage**: Zero persistent disk footprint on the host server; media packets flow directly from Telegram MTProto network to client browser.
- **On-the-Fly Streaming ZIP**: Multi-file downloads packaged into a single uncompressed ZIP stream dynamically in memory.
- **Multi-Tenant Isolation**: Secure visitor session cookies (`televault_session`) with per-user Telegram client sessions and isolated credentials.
- **Authentication**: Supports QR code scanning and phone number/SMS/2FA authentication.
- **SQLite Manifest**: Local tracking of media items, download states, and metadata indexing.

## Key Links & Endpoints
- [TeleVault Landing Page](https://televault.madhudadi.in/): Public overview and feature breakdown.
- [TeleVault Web App](https://televault.madhudadi.in/app): Interactive web dashboard and downloader UI.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://televault.madhudadi.in/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive architectural and developer guide.
